name: I Made a Website Called [Domain Joke] — Product Pitch
description: Opens with a punchline domain name built from a relatable pain point, pitches the product in one line, narrates a quick demo with three flash-cut cutaways of you naming different example prompts, and closes on a comment-to-get-the-link CTA.

slots.name: hook-clip
slots.instructions: Look at the camera in a casual home setting, holding your phone or a mic prop like you're about to record. Say: 'I just made a website called [your relatable pain point turned into a run-on domain name] dot com.' The joke is that the whole sentence literally becomes the URL.
slots.example: I just made a website called ineedmorefollowersbuthatepostingcontent.com

slots.name: hook-headline-text
slots.instructions: Type the exact punchline domain you say out loud in hook-clip, e.g. 'ineedmorefollowersbuthatepostingcontent.com' — shown as the big on-screen reveal. (Kept as its own text field rather than auto-captured from your voice: the engine can only auto-capture up to about 8 spoken words, too short for a full run-on domain sentence.)

phrases: I just made a website called
I just built a website called

slots.name: pitch-clip
slots.instructions: Same setting, talk directly to camera. Say what your product/service actually is in one sentence, then bridge into the demo with something like 'let me show you how it works.'
slots.example: It's an AI video editor that you hire so you never have to edit again. Let me show you how it works.

blocks.title: Demo — narrated walkthrough with screen-recording cutaways

slots.name: demo-clip
slots.instructions: Continuous talking-head take narrating how your product works, casual/energetic tone. Include a marker line right before you describe the first step, optionally rattling off a few example prompts/requests you could give it, then a marker line right before you describe the payoff/result.
slots.example: Just dump all of your raw files in and talk to it like a friend — make me a car-style video, make me a tier list video, make me a ranking video, whatever you want. And it cooks up a polished video for you in seconds.

slots.name: demo-screencap-1
slots.instructions: A quick cutaway clip of you naming your FIRST example prompt/request — you on camera (or doing something illustrative), saying something like 'make me a car-style video.' Doesn't need to be a screen recording — any short action shot of you delivering that line works.

slots.name: demo-screencap-2
slots.instructions: A quick cutaway clip of you naming your SECOND example prompt/request (e.g. 'make me a tier list video'), same style as the first cutaway.

slots.name: demo-screencap-3
slots.instructions: A quick cutaway clip of you naming your THIRD example prompt/request (e.g. 'make me a ranking video'), same style as the first two cutaways.

blocks.title: CTA — comment to get the link

slots.name: cta-clip
slots.instructions: Talking head, energetic close. Mention it's free right now, then say 'just comment [your chosen keyword] and I'll send you the link', then a quick sign-off.
slots.example: By the way guys, this tool is totally free to use right now, so just comment EDITOR and I'll send you the link. Bye!!!
